notes: «قال عبد الله حدثنا أبو يزيد» writes عبد الله again after مروان; the text does not say he is the co-transmitter named earlier, so the two are not merged (rule 9). Flagged here for review.
«- قال محمود الصدفي -» and «- وكان شيخ صدق ... -» are editor's glosses, left out.
